NGA.note: INEC finds AI-generated photos in its register, but the document names no rule, authority or dated enforcement on AI harms.
No AI system used by a government body for its work or services is stated.

facts.fact: INEC's ICT director Lawrence Bayode said the Automated Biometric Identification System was run on the registration records of the preliminary voters' register, finding irregular entries.
facts.system: INEC preliminary register of voters / Automated Biometric Identification System

facts.fact: The preliminary register of voters was uploaded to INEC's website on 26 October 2026, where the public could view it and complain of missing details.

NGA.note: The document concerns the voters' register, not a national ID system.
